modules.title: Introduction to Ohun ati Abidi (Sounds and Alphabet)
modules.html:
The Yoruba alphabet, vowels, consonants and tones. This section covers introduction to ohun ati abidi (sounds and alphabet).

Key points

  • Inú fọ́nẹ́tíìkì, 'e' ati 'ẹ' jẹ́ fọ́wẹ́lì _____. — Àìránmú.
  • Kí ni ohun tí a ń lò láti fi kọ àmì ohùn 're' nínú gírámà Yorùbá — Kò sí àmì.
  • Kí ni ohun tí a ń lò nínú ìsọmọlórúkọ láti dúró fún 'Ìtura' — Omi.
  • Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ohun èlò kọ̀ǹpútà nínú èdè Yorùbá — Gbogbo rẹ̀.
  • Kí ni 'Ẹ̀mí' nínú ohun tí ó wà lórí ilẹ̀ — Èèyàn.

Worked examples

Q: Inú fọ́nẹ́tíìkì, 'e' ati 'ẹ' jẹ́ fọ́wẹ́lì _____.
A: Àìránmú — 'e' and 'ẹ' are oral vowels (fọ́wẹ́lì àìránmú) because air flows only through the mouth during their production.

Q: Kí ni ohun tí a ń lò láti fi kọ àmì ohùn 're' nínú gírámà Yorùbá?
A: Kò sí àmì — The mid-tone (re) is typically left unmarked in Yoruba orthography.

examples.q: Kí ni ohun tí a ń lò láti fi kọ àmì ohùn 're' nínú gírámà Yorùbá?

quiz.q: Inú fọ́nẹ́tíìkì, 'e' ati 'ẹ' jẹ́ fọ́wẹ́lì _____.
quiz.solution: 'e' and 'ẹ' are oral vowels (fọ́wẹ́lì àìránmú) because air flows only through the mouth during their production.

quiz.q: Kí ni ohun tí a ń lò láti fi kọ àmì ohùn 're' nínú gírámà Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: The mid-tone (re) is typically left unmarked in Yoruba orthography.

quiz.q: Kí ni ohun tí a ń lò nínú ìsọmọlórúkọ láti dúró fún 'Ìtura'?
quiz.solution: Water (Omi) is used in ceremonies to symbolize coolness and comfort (ìtura).

quiz.q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ohun èlò kọ̀ǹpútà nínú èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: These are Yoruba terms for screen, mouse/pen, and buttons.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Ẹ̀mí' nínú ohun tí ó wà lórí ilẹ̀?
quiz.solution: A person (Èèyàn) is the primary vessel for 'Ẹ̀mí' in human context.

quiz.q: Kí ni ohun tí Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Family'?
quiz.solution: Family is 'Ẹ̀bí'.

quiz.q: Àmì ohun mélòó ni ó wà nínú èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Mẹ́ta.

quiz.q: Kí ni ohun èlò orin 'Gángan'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Drum.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Ọ̀pẹ' nínú ohun ọ̀gbìn Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Palm tree.

quiz.q: Ìdàkejì 'Pupa' ni:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Dúdú.

quiz.q: Òwe: 'Adìyẹ funfun...'
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Kò mọ ara rẹ̀ lágbà.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'King'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Ọba.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ àmì ohùn tí ó wà lórí ọ̀rọ̀ 'bàbá'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Do-Do.

quiz.q: Èwo ni kọnsonanti tí a máa ń pè ní 'Syllabic Nasal'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: m, n.

quiz.q: Èwo ni ẹranko tí a fi ń ṣe àpèjúwe 'Agbára'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Kìnnìún.

quiz.q: Ọba wo ni ó kọ́kọ́ jẹ ní Ọ̀yọ́?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ọ̀ráńyàn.

quiz.q: Iru aṣọ wo ni àwọn Yorùbá máa ń wọ̀ fún ayẹyẹ pàtàkì?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Aṣọ Òkè.

quiz.q: Orúkọ wo ni a ń pe ọmọ tí a bí lẹ́yìn ìbejì?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Ìdòwú.

quiz.q: Ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó lòdì sí 'Mímọ́' ni...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Èérí.

quiz.q: Àṣà 'Ìrágún' wà fún...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ìgbéyàwó.

quiz.q: Àṣà 'Ìborí' jẹ́ fún...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ẹ̀sìn Ìbílẹ̀.

quiz.q: Iye fáwẹ̀lì àránmú ní èdè Yorùbá jẹ́:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Márùn-ún.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Plural' ní èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ọ̀pọ̀.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìdàkejì 'Dúdú'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Funfun.

quiz.q: Èwo ni ó pinnu àṣà Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Gbogbo wọn.
